extras.subject: Governing law
extras.note: The Letter of Intent is governed by the laws of England and Wales, whereas the Side Letter selects the laws of the State of New York for itself and any dispute arising out of it.

left.quote: This letter is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

right.quote:
The parties agree that this Side Letter, and any dispute arising out of
it, shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
